notes.title: Early Access Update 1 In Progress
notes.content:
Hi All!

I'm working on a set of new features I will be packaging in a first big update to the game, hopefully about 3 months from now.  

I post daily what I am working on over at [url=https://twitter.com/BearHammerGames]https://twitter.com/BearHammerGames[/url]

Here are the big features coming for this first update:

[list]
[*] Adding Snap Turn Movement Option
[*] New Map with Open World Feel--no more waves, game will play more like skyrim/zelda with different wandering enemies and different boss encounters that pop up as you travel through the world.  
[*] New Dungeon Map--Dungeon Maps are designed to be small, difficult maps with a high density of enemies and some unique terrain/obstacles--clearing these will be difficult!
[*] Improved foliage/trees/lighting 
[*] Improved Tutorial
[*] Improved Settings Menu with laser pointers, no more throwing hammers at widgets
[*] New Character Model & 3rd person locomotion option
[*] New Shop for buying items/upgrades
[*] Climbing System and Climbing Puzzles
[/list]

notes.title: Welcome All New Players!
notes.content:
Hi All New Players, Welcome to the early access launch of BearHammer!

For Early Access launch, we've unlocked wave 5 so if you are looking for more of a challenge right at the start of your session, we suggest trying out wave 5.  For the ultimate challenge, you can activate the endless mode to the left of the start button.

[u][b]Some helpful tips:[/b][/u]

To start the next wave of combat, always return to the center pedestal and throw your hammer at the start button.

To get more feedback on the viking spinners, I've unlocked them for now by default for all players.   Press the top button on the vive or the Y button on oculus to try changing weapons.  

(You can check them out here) https://twitter.com/BearHammerGames/status/1206635126320455680

Don't be afraid to let us know your feedback, we'll be continuing to improve the game and have already gotten a lot of great responses.  

We also encourage you to check out the VR tetherball, rope targets, mushdroom drum set (located in the Bear Village), and riding a dragon/riding a bear features :), as these are fairly unique and we'll develop them further as the game progresses.

Thanks for playing and if you want to share any experiences on social media, tag it with 

#prepareyourbear
